**INT. SLOVENLY OFFICE OF ECCENTRIC AUTOMOTIVE JOURNALIST, FILM CAR SUPPLIER – LATE AFTERNOON**


*Sixty-something dialing phone, taps fingers lightly while phone rings in office of Mini USA communications director.*


JOURNALIST


> That’s great. I’m headed to the U.K. and would genuinely love to try the new electric Mini. Paul Smith Special Edition? Sounds good. We don’t get electric Minis in the States anymore, correct?


MINI USA COMMUNICATIONS DIRECTOR


> Not now. And we don’t get the Paul Smith Cooper here. But, relatedly, you’d be surprised at how many[Mini special editions](https://www.mini.com/en_MS/home/heritage/the-definitive-list-of-mini-special-editions.html) there’ve been.


MINI


**INT. OFFICE, SOFT YELLOW OVERHEAD LIGHT, GLOWING COMPUTER – NIGHT**


*JOURNALIST examines two emails detailing all Mini special editions.*


JOURNALIST


> Holy smokes, that’s a lot of special editions.


**INT. AIRPLANE **–** DAYTIME**


*JOURNALIST attempting to count all Mini special editions. Scrolls through dozens of press releases.*


JOURNALIST *(softly to self)*


> MINI USA Announces Mini Cooper Heritage Edition for U.S. Market… MINI Red Line Edition… 1965 Victory Edition… original Paul Smith Edition… John Cooper Works 1to6 Edition… Clubman Final Edition… Coopers S Convertible Seaside Edition… 20th Anniversary Edition… Multitone Edition… Resolute Edition… Pat Moss Edition… Brick Lane Edition… Untold Edition… Untamed Edition…


*A random PASSENGER looks, confused, vaguely annoyed, goes to sleep.*


**INT. AIRPLANE – NIGHTTIME**


JOURNALIST *(drones on to self, visibly tiring)*


> Mini Anniversary Edition… Coral Red Edition… Boardwalk Edition… Sidewalk Edition… John Cooper Works Edition… John Cooper Works GP… 60 Years Edition… John Cooper Works Knights Edition (2012… John Cooper Works Hardtop International Orange Edition… New Mini Seven…


**INT. AIRPLANE – NIGHTTIME, CONTINUED**


*Pan passengers waking up, gathering belongings.*


PILOT’S VOICE ON LOUDSPEAKER


> The plane has begun its descent. Now would be a good time…


JOURNALIST


> Countryman Park Lane… Clubman Bond Street… John Cooper Works GP (2019… Mini Hyde Park… Mini Green Park… Mini Baker Street… Mini Bayswater…


**EXT. BOEING 787 LANDS AT LONDON HEATHROW AIRPORT – PLANE TAXIS TO GATE – NIGHTTIME**


**INT. – PASSENGERS PREPARE TO LEAVE PLANE**


JOURNALIST *(still mumbling)*


> Mini Inspired by Goodwood… John Cooper Works World Championship 50 Edition… John Cooper Works with GP Kit… Commemorative Edition Mini Cooper S MC40… Mini Convertible Highgate… Mini Electric Collection for the Mini Cooper SE… Oxford Edition… Oxford Edition Countryman… Cooper 1499 GT…


**INT. MAD MILE-LONG DASH TO CUSTOMS**


*Passport placed in scanner. Glass door opens. JOURNALIST smiles, walks through portal to U.K. Descends escalator.*


**INT. BAGGAGE CAROUSEL, LATER**


*JOURNALIST waits for suitcases, runs into PASSENGER also collecting luggage, who turns to JOURNALIST.*


PASSENGER


> It occurs to me. Did you possibly overlook the special editions of the original Mini, starting in 1976?


*JOURNALIST horrified look on face.*


JOURNALIST


> Thanks for that. *(Smiles wanly.)*


**EXT. SISTER’S LONDON FLAT – NIGHTTIME**


SISTER AJ


> Go to bed.


*JOURNALIST sitting upright on air mattress in living room, mumbles distractedly to SISTER.*


JOURNALIST


> In a minute… *(yawns)*
>
>
> (Continues) Mini Limited Edition 1000, AKA “Stripey”… Mini 25… Mini Ritz… Mini Piccadilly… Mini Chelsea… Mini Sky… Mini Flame… Mini Racing… Mini Rose… Limited Edition 1000… Mini Cooper RSP… Mini British Open Classic… Mini Italian Job… Mini Cooper Monte Carlo… Mini Cooper Sports LE… Mini John Cooper LE… One-Off Designer Paul Smith… Mini Paul Smith…


Jamie Kitman


**EXT. CENTRAL LONDON SQUARE – EARLY AFTERNOON**


*JOURNALIST collects keys to 2026 MINI Cooper SE Paul Smith Edition, loads luggage, adjusts seat and mirrors, connects to Bluetooth, enters destination coordinates in phone, map mirrored in central flat screen and heads off.*


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman


**EXT. COTSWOLDS AIRBNB, A CONVERTED CIRCULAR TWO-STORY “DOVE HOUSE” – LATE AFTERNOON**


HOST *(enthusiastic middle-aged woman)*


> In olden times, during winter, when the chicken wouldn’t lay eggs, doves would. Each of these little indentations in the wall held a dove’s nest, where they might lay eggs. Now tell me about your electric Mini. I don’t think I could own one as the charging is too difficult.


JOURNALIST


> I’ve driven several electric cars in the U.K. and it gets better each time I do. Widely available on the motorway and in most city centers, high-speed charging is not too difficult to find. Twenty-eight minutes will charge the Cooper from 10 to 80 percent, range is decent—rated at 242 miles, though at highway speeds I saw more like 210 miles. I’ve been a critic of Mini’s ever-expanding length and weight gain through the BMW years, but I have to say I really enjoy this one.
>
>
> Performance is brisk—6.7 seconds to 60 mph—and the electric motor’s instant torque makes for easy entry onto motorways and for darting into tight spaces.
>
>
> Steering is very sharp, ride not bad. And while I pine for the oh-so-right looks of earlier Minis, both the original and Gen 1 of the 21st century Minis, this two-door hatch feels big on the inside but small on the outside and has quickly wormed its way into my affections. The Paul Smith touches are cosmetic—colors, trim, and materials—but make for an extra handsome alternative. Love its big green mirrors. And if the American market is anything to go by, these special editions, rare by definition and intention, develop their own dedicated following. Too bad they won’t sell any new Mini electrics in the U.S. For now.


Jamie Kitman


**EXT. DRIVING MONTAGE – DAY TIME**


**DRONE SHOT:**


*JOURNALIST seen driving Paul Smith Edition Mini Cooper through the English countryside, with stops including Lechlade (to pick up parts for British 1993 Ford Transit van he has back home) and Bibury in the Cotswolds. Bicester in Oxfordshire, Bath in Somerset, Norwich in Norfolk, Wetheringsett near Debenham in Suffolk, Mundesley in Norfolk, and return to London. Weather varies from bright sunshine to torrential rain.*


*Over the course of 900 miles, JOURNALIST visits several charging stations without troubling incident. He reads hours of email and online blather while charging, with occasional breaks to peruse 19th century novelist Anthony Trollope’s The Way We Live Now. Marvels at how crude and crass things were then and how much they sometimes seem the same, the way we live now.*


**INT. JOURNALIST’S DIMLY LIT OFFICE**


JOURNALIST


> So then. Limited editions. A marketing gimmick that has stood the test of time. As it happened, I really liked this one.
>
>
> And speaking of limited editions, this is the 50th and last installment of *Picture Car Confidential* . It’s been a treat, folks. I’ll see you down the lonesome highway somewhere real soon.


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman


Jamie Kitman
